stem: Why does the author use personification in this quotation?
instruction:
Read the following from paragraph 8.

The ball drops to the ground at the boy's feet. It lies there stunned, quivering, containing flight beneath its smooth skin.

options.label: F
options.text: The baseball game symbolizes the love of the family.

options.label: G
options.text: The description mimics the boy's disappointment.

options.label: H
options.text: The author is comparing the ball to a bird.

options.label: J
options.text: The author is showing the distance the ball has traveled.

visual_elements: The ball drops to the ground at the boy's feet. It lies there stunned, quivering, containing flight beneath its smooth skin.
